restart_interval.description: Seconds between automatic restarts of the tzc process. Set to 0 or null to disable.

exposure.description: User exposure level. Must be one of: NONE, OPSTAFF, REALM-VISIBLE, REALM-ANNOUNCED, NET-VISIBLE, NET-ANNOUNCED.

location_tty.description: Custom tty identifier for zlocation. If empty, defaults to tzc.<pid>.

location_hostname.description: Custom hostname for zlocation. If empty, defaults to the current host's hostname.

pid_file.description: Path to a file where the process ID will be written. If empty, no PID file is created.

use_zctl.description: If true, use zctl for subscriptions (reads from ~/.zephyr.subs.tzc).

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds to wait before sending a test message to ensure connectivity. Set to 0 to disable.

output_only.description: If true, run in output-only mode (print zephyrgrams, do not accept stdin commands).

ignore_eof.description: If true, ignore EOF on input.
